title: Blue Feather
wikitext:
[[File:HM64_bfeather_clear.png|thumb]]
Left by a rare and exotic blue bird, the '''Blue Feather''' acts as an engagement ring in the ''Harvest Moon'' and ''Story of Season'' series.

The player can use it to propose to the bachelors and bachelorettes in every game, and it is widely known as a popular tradition in the Harvest Moon world.

''also see [[Marriage]]''
